definition: The matched full/visible hidden-network pair has a state-level response invariant with tr(Lambda_full)>tr(Lambda_vis), and this trace gap is independent of port naming/relabeling.
math: DeltaLambda_H >=_PSD 0, DeltaLambda_H != 0 => tr(DeltaLambda_H)>0 => tr(Lambda_full)>tr(Lambda_vis). For permutation P, tr(P Lambda P^T)=tr(Lambda).
